questions.q: If P means +, Q means −, R means × and S means ÷, what is 8 R 2 S 4 Q 6 P 2?
Deepak walks 8 m West, then turns left and walks 2 m, then turns right and walks 6 m. Which direction is Deepak facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the West. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If 6 August 2022 was a Saturday, what day of the week was 30 August 2022?
questions.why: 24 days later; 24 mod 7 = 3, so count 3 days on from Saturday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a row of 34 students, Ravi is 6th from the left and Asha is 18th from the right. How many students sit between them?
M is the father of N. N is the sister of O. O is the husband of P. How is P related to M?
questions.why: O is M's son and P is O's wife, so P is M's daughter-in-law.

questions.q: In a row of 32 students, Deepak is 12th from the left and Meera is 12th from the right. How many students sit between them?
If A = 1, B = 2, …, Z = 26, what is the sum of the letters in EXAMINATION?
questions.why: 5+24+1+13+9+14+1+20+9+15+14 = 125, which is not listed. GPSC's printed key said 150; the sum is 125, so E. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: If MOTHER is written as TGJVQO in a certain code, how is SUMMER written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 2 places forward and the word is then reversed: SUMMER → TGOOWU. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: The Collectorate is due north of the bus stand. The court is due east of the Collectorate. In which direction is the bus stand from the court?
questions.why: From the court, the bus stand lies to the west and to the south, that is, south-west.

questions.q: In a group of 70 people, 31 like cricket, 24 like football and 32 like neither. How many like only cricket?
questions.why: Both = 31 + 24 − (70 − 32) = 17; only cricket = 31 − 17 = 14. GPSC-style practice item.
